messages:
Noah Kim: hi team, Noah here — starting on Infra today. Need access to Redwood Console staging (full FF admin) and prod console read-only to validate integration. Who handles the approvals?
Ravi Desai: Welcome Noah! I own staging grants. For prod readonly we need a security checklist sign-off. Can you post your manager and team?
Noah Kim: Manager: Ravi Desai. Team: Infra Runtime. Will only be toggling non-critical flags in staging.
Ravi Desai: perfect. Noah, please open the Access Request form: https://internal.redwood/accessr and request roles: `console.staging.flag_admin` + `console.prod.readonly`. Put ONB-546 in the ticket and set me as approver.
Noah Kim: submitted ONB-546, shows "pending". I attached my manager approval note.
Harper (devex): tagging the checklist: 1) SSO active 2) 2FA enrolled 3) Security training ack. If any are missing sec-bot will block.
sec-bot: Security check: 2FA status = not enrolled for user noah.kim.
Noah Kim: I thought I enrolled during initial setup... checking.
Noah Kim: ok enrolled now via Authy. Can you re-run the check?
sec-bot: Security check: 2FA status = enrolled. Security training = not completed.
Noah Kim: I'll finish the training now, expected done in 20 min.
Ravi Desai: no rush. Once training complete I'll approve staging. Prod readonly needs final security ack, looping in sec.
sec-bot: Security training completed for user noah.kim (timestamp 1794129098).
Ravi Desai: Approved staging role — you should be added to `console-staging-admins` group. Prod readonly approved by security as read-only.
Harper (devex): Note: when testing flags use the `staging/canary` environment and avoid toggling `global` keys. See runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/flags/onboard.
Noah Kim: Got it — I can access staging and see the flag list. Prod is read-only as expected. Thanks y'all! :party_parrot:
Noah Kim: small Q: who do I ping if a staging flag publish fails with a 500?
Ravi Desai: ping #eng-oncall and include the `deploy-id` and logs. If it's during your onboarding tag me and Harper.
Noah Kim: will do. Closing thread.
